comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (32.11%) to rtCATH_1 GRAVY: -0.828; Mol Wt: 11521.707; mol formula: C488H758N146O157S7; mol ex Coeff: 18925. Activity: active against Gram-positive bacteria: B.subtilis (MIC 100–1000 ug/ml), M. luteus (MIC 1–10 ug/ml), and S. aureus (MIC 10–100 µg/ml), but not against Gram-negative bacteria (E.coli, E.cloacae, Pantoea sp., the gut symbiont of P.stal, MIC >1000 ug/ml i) and Gram+ (E. faecalis and E.faecium, MIC >1000 ug/ml).
title: A new antimicrobial peptide, Pentatomicin, from the stinkbug Plautia stali
